description: This is a Python source file implementing the PostHog integration. It defines a class PostHogLogger that extends CustomBatchLogger to send analytics events related to large language models (LLMs) to PostHog. The class manages event payload creation, batching, asynchronous and synchronous event logging, and handles environment variable configurations.

classes.name: PostHogLogger
classes.description: A logger class that captures LLM analytics events, batches them, and sends to PostHog via synchronous or asynchronous HTTP requests. It manages environment configurations, event payload creation, and graceful shutdown handling for pending events.

methods.name: __init__(self, **kwargs)
methods.description: Initializes the PostHogLogger, verifies environment variables, sets up HTTP clients, and registers exit handler.

methods.name: log_success_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Sends a successful model event to PostHog synchronously.

methods.name: async_log_success_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Queues an asynchronous successful event for batch processing.

methods.name: async_log_failure_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Queues an asynchronous failed event for batch processing.

methods.name: _log_async_event(self, kwargs, response_obj=None, start_time=0.0, end_time=0.0)
methods.description: Internal method to add an event to the queue for asynchronous processing.

methods.name: PostHogEventPayload create_posthog_event_payload(self, kwargs: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Creates a PostHog event payload object based on request kwargs.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _create_posthog_properties( self, standard_logging_object: StandardLoggingPayload, kwargs: Dict[str, Any], event_name: str, )
methods.description: Builds the properties dictionary for the event, including model info, input/output, tokens, costs, error info, trace, and metadata.

methods.name: _add_trace_properties(self, properties: Dict[str, Any], kwargs: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Adds tracing identifiers such as trace id, span id, and parent run id to properties.

methods.name: _add_custom_metadata_properties(self, properties: Dict[str, Any], kwargs: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Includes custom metadata fields in event properties, excluding internal litellm fields.

methods.name: str _get_distinct_id( self, standard_logging_object: StandardLoggingPayload, kwargs: Dict[str, Any] )
methods.description: Determines the distinct user ID for the event, prioritizing user_id, end_user, trace_id, or generating a UUID.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[str],Optional[str]] _get_credentials_for_request(self, kwargs: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Retrieves PostHog API key and URL from request-specific or default environment variables.

methods.name: async_send_batch(self)
methods.description: Actually sends the queue of logged events in batch asynchronously.

methods.name: _ensure_async_setup(self)
methods.description: Initializes asynchronous components like lock and periodic flushing.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _extract_metadata(self, kwargs: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Extracts metadata dictionary from request parameters.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _create_posthog_payload(self, events: list, api_key: str)
methods.description: Prepares the batch payload to send to PostHog.

methods.name: Any _safe_get(self, obj: Any, key: str, default: Any = None)
methods.description: Safely retrieves a key from a dictionary, returning a default if not found.

methods.name: _flush_on_exit(self)
methods.description: Flushes remaining queued events when the program terminates, ensuring no data loss.
